user.title: HEMS Master
user.description: Connect the dynamic price sensor (full all-in or bare) and the EV charger MID meter. You can add a separate bare price and ERE settings in the financial step.

data.name: Name
data.price_entity: Dynamic price sensor (full all-in or bare)

sources.title: Auto-detect source devices
sources.description: Optionally select the devices from Solarman, Frank Quarter Prices, HomeWizard, EVCC and Joulo. HEMS will prefill matching power, price, battery and EV entities. You can correct everything in the next step.

entities.title: Entity mapping
entities.description: Select your existing entities. HEMS Master normalises power (W/kW), current (A/mA), energy (kWh/Wh) and SOC. Leave fields empty when an entity is not available.

finance.title: Financial parameters
finance.description: Enter the all-in dynamic import price in the price sensor. Rates are in euro per kWh and can also be changed from the dashboard later.

data.price_entity: Dynamic price sensor (full all-in or bare)
data.price_forecast_entity: Price forecast sensor (optional, with prices attribute)
data.battery_trade_min_spread: Minimum buy/sell spread for battery trading
data.employer_pays_dynamic: Eflux/employer reimburses the bare dynamic price
data.price_entity_is_bare: The selected price sensor is the bare price

grid.title: Grid and EV limits
grid.description: The grid current sensor must measure the whole service, including the EV charger and heat pump. HEMS subtracts the EV current to calculate the other load.

data.ev_control_enabled: Allow HEMS to control the EV charger

modbus.title: Deye connection
modbus.description: Modbus writes are disabled by default. Use the existing Solarman integration (port 8899) or direct Modbus TCP (port 502). Enable monitoring first, verify the register map with your inverter, then enable writes. The integration always uses the register 1100 unlock/lock sequence.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Deye inverter. Check the IP address, port, unit ID and Modbus TCP setting.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname, without http:// or a path.
error.entity_not_found: One of the required entities does not exist in Home Assistant.
error.solarman_not_configured: The Solarman integration is not loaded or has no compatible read service.
error.solarman_write_unavailable: This Solarman version has no write services. Update Solarman or use direct Modbus TCP.

init.title: HEMS Master options
init.description: Choose what to change. Existing runtime values can be tuned from the dashboard.

sources.title: Auto-detect source devices
sources.description: Select the devices to rescan. Matching entities are pre-filled; existing mappings without a match are kept.

entities.title: Entity mapping
entities.description: Change the optional source and actuator entities.

recalculate.description: Refresh entity readings and recalculate the financial ledger.

export_audit.name: Export audit
export_audit.description: Return stored MID sessions and ledger data for the NEa/ERE audit.
